configurePresets.name: dev-base
configurePresets.description: Ninja + Release + tests. OpenMP stays at the project default (ON): CMakeLists auto-detects LLVM libomp for clang/clang-cl on Windows, and prints the libomp.dll PATH requirement at configure time. Run from a VS x64 developer environment (vcvars64) so Ninja finds the toolchain.

configurePresets.name: cpu-full
configurePresets.displayName: CPU, full model set, unified ABI + transcribe arches
configurePresets.description: The configuration the merge is validated against on CPU (progress.md test baseline; includes abi_bridge_hello / abi_stream_hello / asr_e2e_wer_test).

configurePresets.name: cpu-core
configurePresets.displayName: CPU, core model set (lean, fast iteration)
configurePresets.description: Same ABI surface as cpu-full but links no optional models. Lean sets with tests ON are a supported configuration (plan R10.5) — a link failure here is a bug, not a limitation.

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.description: The configuration the ggml convergence was GPU-certified against (plan R10, RTX 4070 / sm_89 / CUDA 13.3). nvcc requires the MSVC host compiler on Windows, so no compiler override — the vcvars environment decides.

configurePresets.name: client-base
configurePresets.description: Ninja + Release for client apps. Excludes server/WebUI and unselected models, enables C APIs.

configurePresets.name: client-compact-minimized-cpu
configurePresets.description: Lightweight client build profile with curated STT+TTS models (Supertonic, Nemotron ASR, Granite Speech 2B, Qwen3 ASR, Parakeet TDT). WebUI server and unused models excluded.

configurePresets.name: client-compact-minimized-cuda
configurePresets.description: Lightweight client build profile with curated STT+TTS models and CUDA acceleration.
